name: Extra Equipment Slots
pages: In addition to the {b}4 armor slots{/} in the {l:user_interface/inventory}inventory{/l}, players have several more slots to equip items.{pb}Click on the icon in the top-right corner of the avatar window to expand the {b}Curios slots{/} to the left side of your inventory. An item that can be equipped in a Curios slot will say in its {l:user_interface/tooltips}tooltip{/l} which slot it can fill.

Press {k:cos.key.opencosarmorinventory/k} or click on the icon in the bottom-right corner of the avatar window in your inventory to toggle your {b}cosmetic armor{/} slots. These slots can have the same types of items equipped as your regular armor slots, but are for {b}purely aesthetic{/} purposes, and can determine what other players see you wearing. Enchantments and armor points won't apply for any gear equipped in these slots.

For example, say you have diamond armor in your regular armor slots and gold armor in your cosmetic armor slots. You will have the {i}protection and enchantments{/} of only the diamond armor, but it will {i}look like{/} your character is wearing gold armor instead.{pb}This is a great way to customize your character's appearance without giving up the protection of your armor!

Each cosmetic armor slot also has a small button on it. If the button is toggled {b}on{/}, the item in that slot will be {b}visible{/} to other players (or the item in your corresponding regular armor slot, if that cosmetic armor slot is empty). If toggled {b}off{/}, that item will be {b}invisible{/}, making it look like you don't have any armor equipped in that slot.
